description: This file implements the ControlClientServerInternal class, which manages IPC communication for control events such as application state changes and pings within the Rialto server. It includes methods to send events via an IPC client, and a helper function to convert application state enums.

classes.name: ControlClientServerInternal
classes.description: A class responsible for managing IPC communication for control events such as application state changes and pings.

methods.name: ControlClientServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control ID and IPC client.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Sends an application state change event via IPC.

methods.description: Sends a ping event with a specified ID via IPC.
